release_notes:
## Checking for existing episodes is much faster
- The pre-nest check only ever needed the NAMES of already-nested episodes, but was building a live reference to each one first — a separate round trip to Premiere per episode, and on a show with 60-90 already nested that was most of the wait. Names now come back with the search itself, in one call
- Nesting only builds references for episodes this reel could actually collide with, instead of every nested episode in the project

## Reset Reel and Nest All
- "Reset Reel" is greyed out in the ••• menu while Nest All is on. With Nest All there is no single reel to act on — the timeline dropdown is locked for the same reason — and it would quietly have reset every reel, which is what Reset All is for
